messages:
mike: deploy-bot just detected a spike in 5xx (private-vpc/dedicated) after rollout to v6.0.1 in eu-central. Autorollback scheduled in 10m. tagging ops/legal/product/support for hold/veto. telemetry: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/3229998888

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Private-VPC/dedicated 5xx increased from 0.2% -> 3.8% on inference-route. Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK -> v5.9.4 in 10m unless overridden. Possible culprit: new mmap allocator flag. See detailed traces: /telemetry/trace/3229998888

ops-oncall: oncall here. request 6m hold to run focused probes and avoid noisy rollback across private customers. last full rollback caused cache warming issues.

support: Customer X reported degraded throughput and timeouts 12:03-12:07 UTC. they are on private-vpc dedicated. requesting we confirm impact before rolling back.

eng-runtime: quick look at traces: memory alloc failures and transient shard reconnects correlated with mmap change. this may only hit private pools with strict ulimits. patch is quick but needs a few mins to build. recommend hold for operator to allow targeted partial rollback if needed.

product: if this impacts private customers we should avoid a global rollback that affects hosted customers. prefer route/pool-level rollback. also note: two enterprise customers are in a change-window freeze; notify them if we take action.

legal: FYI - any targeted action affecting private customers in regulated accounts must be recorded. notify legal when action is taken; we'll prepare compliance note.

mike: operator plan: reduce autorollback to 6m, run probes at +1m and +4m, if errors >3% sustained then execute manual partial rollback to v5.9.4 for private-vpc pools only. Sophia will run rollback and comms.

sophia: ack. rollback steps (manual partial):
```
# partial rollback for private-vpc/dedicated
infra pin-pool --region eu-central --pool private-vpc --version 5.9.4
infra traffic-slice --pool private-vpc --from 10%->100% --window 20s
infra monitor --pool private-vpc --check errors,p95 --duration 10m
```
Also will run `sentry query` and heap-snapshots before action.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorollback timer adjusted to 6m by operator override. Current timer: 6m.

ops-oncall: running probe1 -> `for i in {1..25}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://private-eu.infra/infer/health; sleep 0.4; done`

ops-oncall: probe1 results: error-rate 2.9%, p95 +22%. trending but not yet over threshold.

support: Customer X confirmed partial recovery on their end. they still see some errors at 25% of traffic. kept them in the loop.

eng-runtime: building quick revert patch that disables mmap flag at runtime; ETA ~12m. if we can hold, patch could avoid rollback. weigh tradeoffs: rollback safer short-term but warms caches.

mike: decision point at +4m. if errors >3% at +4m we roll back; if <=3% we hold and let patch land. sophia standby.

ops-oncall: probe2 at +4m -> error-rate 3.4% (sustained 3m). crossing threshold. recommending manual partial rollback now.

sophia: executing partial rollback steps now. will pin and flip traffic slice to 5.9.4 for private-vpc.

ops-oncall: pin-pool complete. traffic-slice 10%->100% started.

deploy-bot: ACTION: partial rollback executing for private-vpc -> v5.9.4. Autorollback canceled by operator during manual execution.

ops-oncall: monitoring 5m in: error-rate down to 0.4%, p95 normalized. heap traces show allocator flag not present on rolled-back version.

legal: acknowledged. preparing compliance note with timestamps and rationale. sophia please include exact CLI logs.

support: notifying Customer X under emergency exception, will follow up with account-eng for post-action debrief.

product: freezing release notes for v6.0.1 until postmortem. please add annotation to release tracker: "partial rollback for private-vpc due to mmap allocator regression".

eng-runtime: filing INF-5200: mmap allocator flag regression affecting private pools. will prioritize patch and regression tests.

mike: closing thread: manual partial rollback executed, autorollback canceled, monitoring continues. comms: internal note posted; customer-facing note on hold pending legal review. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
